Hygene Manager
description:
Job ID: REQ10388215
Four Seasons Venice
Location: Venezia, Venezia, Italy
widget: Full time
  
**About Four Seasons:**


Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world\-class employee experience and company culture.
  

  

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

**About the location:**


Overlooking the Venetian Lagoon and just steps from Piazza San Marco, Danieli, a Four Seasons Hotel, Venice is an iconic property offering elegant, spacious accommodations. The historic hotel showcases majestic Venetian architecture dating back to the 14th century. Guests can also enjoy spectacular views of Venice’s landmarks from the rooftop Restaurant Terrazza Danieli.**About the Role**


The Hygiene Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining the highest standards of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and regulatory compliance across the Food \& Beverage department including Culinary, Stewarding, and back\-of\-house operations. This role ensures full compliance with HACCP standards, local regulations, and company policies while promoting a culture of safety, cleanliness, and continuous improvement throughout the hotel.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead and oversee all food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and pest control programs across the property.
* Ensure full compliance with HACCP standards, local health regulations, occupational safety requirements, and company policies.
* Develop, implement, and monitor hygiene procedures, risk assessments, and corrective action plans.
* Conduct regular internal audits and inspections across kitchens, restaurants, bars, stewarding areas, storage facilities, and back\-of\-house operations.
* Monitor food handling practices, temperature controls, cleaning schedules, and sanitation procedures.
* Investigate hygiene\-related incidents, non\-conformities, and guest complaints, implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Collaborate closely with Culinary, Food \& Beverage Service, Stewarding, Engineering, Housekeeping, and Purchasing teams to maintain operational compliance.
* Prepare documentation, reports, and records required for audits, certifications, and regulatory inspections.
* Lead hygiene and food safety training programs for employees and department leaders.
* Monitor cleaning chemicals, sanitation products, and hygiene equipment to ensure proper use and effectiveness.
* Support events, and operational projects by providing food safety and hygiene guidance.
* Promote a culture of awareness, accountability, and continuous improvement regarding hygiene and workplace safety.

**What You Bring**

* Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in Food Safety, Hygiene Management, Quality Assurance, or a related role within luxury hospitality or large F\&B operations.
* Strong knowledge of HACCP, food safety regulations, sanitation standards, and risk management principles.
* Relevant certifications in Food Safety, HACCP, ISO 22000, or equivalent are preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to conduct inspections, audits, and training sessions effectively.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and reporting systems.
* Fluency in Italian and English.
* Must have the rights to work in Italy.
* Flexibility to support operational requirements, including occasional weekends and holidays when necessary.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
* Excellent Training and Development opportunities.
* Employee Discount for stays at any Four Seasons worldwide.
* Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms.
* Complimentary Employee Meals.

**Schedule \& Location**

* Full\-time position based at Hotel Danieli, Venice.
* Occasional flexibility required to support audits, inspections, special events, and operational needs.
* You must possess the legal right to work in Italy.

Dentsply Sirona develops, manufactures, and markets a comprehensive solutions offering including dental and oral health products as well as other consumable medical devices under a strong portfolio of world class brands.

For Zhermack S.p.A., our manufacturing site in Badia Polesine (RO), we are looking for a:  


**R\&D Product Development Engineer – Fixed\-Term Contract**  



Reporting to the R\&D Dental Manager, the successful candidate will join a multidisciplinary Research \& Development team and will be responsible for the development, testing, and aging studies of silicones and alginates, supporting Supply Chain activities. * Collaborate with suppliers in the qualification of new raw materials and components.
* Ensure technical compliance, product quality, and adherence to regulatory and market requirements.
* Provide data and reports to the R\&D Documentation Specialist to support the preparation of technical product documentation.
* Identify root causes of non\-conformities and propose corrective actions.

  


**Requirements**
* Strong alignment with the company values of **Respect** (for company standards, vision, colleagues, customers, processes, and operating procedures), **Responsibility**, **Collaboration**, **Reliability**, and **Agility** (continuous improvement).
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific field, such as **Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Technology (CTF)**, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Results\-oriented mindset with the ability to work toward objectives.
* Agility and intellectual curiosity, with a genuine interest in change and continuous learning.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Good command of spoken and written English.
* Proficient in the use of standard IT tools and software applications.

description:
**Turn your passion for hiking into a thriving business.**
***We provide the infrastructure; you bring the passion and the vision.***
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


#### **Full Support, No Capital Required**


Are you ready to take the next step in your career and **start a company within a company**? We are looking for passionate people, who want to show the world, what they are capable of. If you have **a passion for a travel destination** (ie. Scandinavian countries, India, North America etc.) or **for a specific style of travel** (ie. vegan food travel, bike tours etc.), **a deep knowledge of the tourism industry and an extended network** it is your time to show your full potential. With your new brand you will have a big impact, we believe by focusing on just one niche, you can provide a superior trips to our travelers. We are looking for experienced professionals, with entrepreneurial spirit, who have their heart in the right place. Please look this video to have a better understanding of the position.

You will collaborate with a young, passionate team of Intrapreneurs, each developing their own brand. You will have the support of the Ventura TRAVEL departments that will help you take your brand to its finest potential

 *(Please note: We only consider applications that include a CV in English.)*

  


***On a daily basis, you will***
--------------------------------


* Grow your travel brand: Support the development and growth of your new niche travel brand to make it a success.
* Build partnerships: Build relationships with local partners in your chosen region or niche to create unique travel experiences.
* Design amazing trips: Create and design memorable trips that will delight your customers.
* Optimize your website: Ensure your brand's website (with the content you provide) showcases your trips in an inspiring way to attract travelers.
* Strategize marketing: Work hand\-in\-hand with Ventura TRAVEL's Marketing team to strategically reach the right customers for your niche.
* Delight our travelers: Put travelers at the center of everything and provide world\-class customer service that truly addresses their needs.
* Lead your team: Hire and lead a team that will help you accomplish all the above and ensure sustainable growth for your brand.

  




***The basics you bring along***
--------------------------------


* Entrepreneurial mindset \& passion for travel: You have a founder mentality with genuine enthusiasm for travel and exploration
* Leadership \& project management: Strong leadership qualities and project management skills to drive your brand forward.
* Communication \& networking: Excellent communication skills and the ability to build a network of partners and customers.
* Language skills: Proficiency in English (our company language). Additional languages (German, French, etc.) are a plus

***You can impress us even more with***
---------------------------------------


* Tourism expertise: Several years of experience in travel and tour operations.
* Analytics savvy: Good knowledge of Google Analytics, Data Studio, or similar analytics tools.
* Team leadership: Experience in leading a team successfully.
* Language proficiency: Fluency in the language(s) of your destination or target market (e.g. German, French) would be an asset.
* CRM experience: Familiarity with CRM systems like HubSpot.
* Additional skills: Any other knowledge or skills that could benefit not just your brand but Ventura TRAVEL as a whole.

***What we promise you***
-------------------------


* *Financial backing: Full financial investment to launch and grow your new brand – no personal capital needed.*
* *Freedom to be creative in achieving results.*
* *International \& friendly working environment.*
* *Quarterly* *Social Days and Team Events.*
* *Work out of* *other offices* *in the Ventura network around the world.*
* *Opportunity to constantly learn and grow.*
* *We care about the well\-being of your employees (regular O3, satisfaction surveys etc.)*
* *Yearly 2\-week\-offsite**, if we achieve our goals.*
* *Participation in the overall company's profits.*
* *Visit our* *Career Page* *to get more insights into our office life.*
* Competitive salary \+ profit sharing: A solid fixed salary, plus a share in the profits of *your* bran

**Support \& Resources for Your New Brand**
-------------------------------------------



From day one, you will have access to Ventura TRAVEL's comprehensive support structure to ensure your new brand thrives:


* Top\-tier software: Use of our in\-house trip management and sales software (it's the world's best – at least in our opinion! ).
* Existing customer base: Access to a pool of tens of thousands of past Ventura TRAVEL customers (from French\-speaking and DACH markets) who are eager for similar experiences in new destinations or travel styles.
* Marketing powerhouse: A creative marketing team dedicated to driving traffic to your website from day one.
* IT infrastructure: A well\-organized IT team that will quickly build you a shiny, responsive, well\-designed website tailored to your brand (ready within weeks).
* Financial support: A fantastic finance team to fund your operations and handle financial admin (they take care of provider payments, accounting, etc., so you can focus on the product).
* Leadership guidance: You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Andre, our CEO, who will ensure you have all the resources and mentorship needed to succeed.

------------------------



Ventura TRAVEL is a **Travel Service Developer** – a global network of tourism experts who create, launch, and support highly specialized, individually branded travel services. All our brands are led by passionate Intrapreneurs with extraordinary travel expertise.



By providing central financial support, IT, marketing, and other shared services, Ventura TRAVEL allows each brand to focus on its individual core competence while leveraging a highly competitive infrastructure. Our mission: to replace ordinary mass\-tourism products with authentic travel experiences crafted by passionate specialists.

**Job title:** Franchise/NPI Artwork Supply Planner


**Locations:** Verona (Italy), Wavre (Belgium), Barnard Castle (UK), Poznan (Polonia)


**Employment type:** Temporary (18\-months), Full\-Time


**Closing date for applications:** 26 August 2026


**Job Purpose:**

As an NPI Artwork Supply Planner, you will play a pivotal role in enabling the successful launch of new products, acquisitions and re\-brand projects by leading artwork\-related activities from regulatory submission through to first launch waves. You will coordinate across markets, site, CMOs, supply chain strategy, Regulatory labelling, external artwork providers and wider artwork and packaging supply chain teams to ensure regulatory mock\-ups and artwork inputs are accurate, compliant and fit for purpose. Acting as a trusted point of contact, you will provide clear guidance on the most effective artwork delivery approach for each business scenario, helping teams navigate complexity, manage priorities and deliver high\-quality outcomes in line with current processes, brand requirements and supply chain expectations.


**Responsibilities**

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:


* Project manage end\-to\-end artwork process steps associated with regulatory submission and first launch waves, aligned with the NPI delivery process.
* Act as the primary artwork contact for assigned NPI and/or NBD projects, attending project meetings and providing guidance on artwork service delivery, priorities and ways of working.
* Manage multiple simultaneous and complex project requirements, ensuring clarity, alignment and timely decision\-making across stakeholders.
* Resolve process and design queries in collaboration with GPO, DTL, Industrialisation, NPI teams and other relevant partners.
* Work with Market, Site, Central and Artwork Provider teams to secure commitment to tasks, timelines and key launch milestones.
* Assess workload and available capacity to support NPI project requirements effectively.
* Take action to maintain service and performance during periods of abnormal demand by aligning priorities and resource allocation with key stakeholders.
* Manage and coordinate major cross\-regional artwork and packaging projects driven by regulatory, portfolio or operational changes beyond NPI or brand change activity.
* Initiate and lead continuous improvement projects in partnership with Service Management teams.
* Support and coach continuous improvement strategy for the team or area, demonstrating progress against plan and sustaining standard ways of working.
* Coordinate updates to Regional Shared Pack Strategy and ensure changes are reflected in the relevant guidelines.

***Why you?***

**Basic Qualifications \& Skills**

**We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:**

* University degree in a technical or business\-related field, ideally with foundational knowledge of supply chain processes.
* Proven experience managing complex projects in cross\-functional and matrix environments.
* Experience supporting global brands and/or new product introduction activities.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, vaccines or FMCG packaging, customer management or artwork delivery environments, with knowledge of commercial print processes, artwork construction, pre\-press stages, colour management and print supplier relationships.
* Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse stakeholder groups.

**Preferred Qualifications \& Soft Skills**

**If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:**

* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to drive issue resolution in complex or changing situations.
* Confidence in managing diverse stakeholder relationships across functions, regions and external partners.
* Ability to deliver effectively against tight deadlines in fast\-moving and evolving decision\-making environments.
* Membership of a relevant supply logistics, artwork or packaging industry body would be an advantage.

***What We Offer:***

* Temporary contract in a very Inclusive environment
* Performance Reward
* Flexible Benefits
* Company Healthcare Plan
* Integrative pension fund
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Tax assistance
